caption: The preview shows 5 notes, 3 notebooks, 2 tags and 2 resources, the output paths, and the report lists before a write.
eval: (async()=>{const p=app.plugins.plugins['joplin-import']; p.closeImportWindows(); p.pro.signOut(); const f=(n)=>app.vault.getFileByPath('Joplin Export Import/'+n); p.settings.folder='Joplin preview'; const m=p.openImport(f('Joplin export.jex')); await m.refreshPreview(); m.contentEl.querySelectorAll('.joplin-import-list').forEach((el)=>{el.open=true;}); m.contentEl.scrollTop=0; return '5 notes, 3 notebooks, 2 tags, 2 resources';})()
after: const p=app.plugins.plugins['joplin-import']; p.closeImportWindows(); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.folder='Joplin import'; p.settings.report=true; 'ok'

caption: An imported note: Joplin links became vault links, the tag and both source dates are in the properties.

after: const p=app.plugins.plugins['joplin-import']; p.closeImportWindows(); p.pro.signOut(); p.settings.folder='Joplin import'; p.settings.report=true; 'ok'
